pass_a_gloss: Abel's blood; precious blood buys; lifted martyr draws all; Peter's death glorifies.
pass_b_english: Abel's blood cries from the ground — and how much more the martyrs' precious blood, which buys others from death! 'For ye were bought with precious blood, as of a lamb unblemished and spotless, of Christ.' (Genesis 4:10) And 'I, if lifted from earth, will draw all unto me.' (1 Peter 1:19) Lifted on the cross of confession, the martyr draws many unto salvation — as Peter was told, 'signifying by what death he shall glorify God.' (John 12:32) So glorify God by death, and live (John 21:19).
